summary: The note describes the South Yemen insurgency, a term the Yemeni government uses for protests and attacks on government forces in southern Yemen since 27 April 2009, South Yemen's independence day. Leaders of the southern secessionist movement say their independence aims are to be pursued peacefully and blame attacks on ordinary citizens responding to government provocations, while the violence is attributed to elements within the movement. The note places the insurgency alongside the Houthi-led Shia insurgency in the north and notes the 1994 failed secession, the movement's ties to former leaders, and reported support from the United Arab Emirates, which is part of the Saudi-led coalition backing President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi.
one_line: Overview of the South Yemen insurgency, southern secessionist protests and attacks on government forces ongoing since April 2009.
key_facts: The South Yemen insurgency is a term used by the Yemeni government to describe protests and attacks on government forces in southern Yemen.
The South Yemen insurgency has been ongoing since 27 April 2009, South Yemen's independence day.
Leaders of the southern secessionist movement maintain that their aims of independence are to be achieved through peaceful means.
Southern leaders claim attacks are from ordinary citizens in response to the government's provocative actions.
The violence has been blamed on elements within the southern secessionist movement.
The South Yemen insurgency comes amid the Shia insurgency in the country's north, led by the Houthi communities.
Southern leaders led a brief, unsuccessful secession in 1994 following unification.
Many leaders of the 1994 secession are involved in the present secession movement.
Southern separatist insurgents are active mainly in the area of former South Yemen.
Southern separatist insurgents are also active in Ad Dali' Governorate, which was not part of the independent southern state.
The separatist insurgents are supported by the United Arab Emirates.
The United Arab Emirates is a member of the Saudi Arabian-led coalition supporting the Yemeni government.
The Saudi Arabian-led coalition works to support the Yemeni government under President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi.
